# Why your agent's copy needs a framework

## Start

This is a short lesson for teams who let an AI agent write their emails, posts and release notes. Today we'll show you a writing framework: a set of rules, tests and reader checks that runs on every draft before anyone sees it, so the agent's copy reads like a person wrote it and gets clicked.

So why is AI copy weak? When an agent writes code, a failing test tells it what went wrong. When it writes copy, nothing tells it anything, so it stops as soon as the text is accurate. That is the gap the framework fills: it gives writing the test that code already has.

## Close

So that's the lesson: copy needs a test, just like code. Next time your agent drafts an email, run it through a check before you send it.
